subject: Pluggable LLM-backend abstraction + Claude provider (foundational)
description: Foundational seam for the pluggable, dashboard-selectable LLM engine (see the superseding design note). Create lib/llm-backend.js: a provider adapter interface + registry. Each provider declares: id, displayName, kind ('agentic-cli' | 'api'). Agentic-CLI providers implement resolveBin()/isAvailable(), isAuthed(), buildInvocation({prompt,model,mcpConfig,addDir,budget})→{bin,args,env}; API providers implement isAuthed() + a callApi()/runJudgeLoop() seam (STUB here — built in the API-backend task). Add getActiveBackend(overlay) reading overlay.config.backend ({provider, model}), defaulting to the Claude provider. Refactor lib/claude-cli.js (resolveClaudeBin / loadEnvForClaude / needsShell) into the CLAUDE provider (kind 'agentic-cli'), keeping claude-cli.js's existing named exports working (re-export from the provider) so current callers (headless-drain.js, onboard-learn.js) do NOT break in this task. Tests: registry register/lookup, Claude provider resolveBin/isAuthed/buildInvocation shape, getActiveBackend default + override. SCOPE = the seam + Claude provider ONLY — drain routing, config/hard-block, dashboard, the API backend, and Codex/Cursor providers are separate downstream tasks blocked on this. Branch off the feature.

summary: Built the foundational pluggable-backend seam. NEW lib/llm-backend.js: provider adapter interface + in-process registry (registerProvider/getProvider/listProviders) supporting both kinds — agentic-cli (spawn local CLI) and api (in-process hosted call). Claude provider (kind agentic-cli) owns resolveClaudeBin/loadEnvForClaude/needsShell (relocated from claude-cli.js) plus resolveBin/isAvailable/isAuthed/buildInvocation (mirrors existing headless `claude -p` flag set: -p/--model/--output-format stream-json/--verbose/--dangerously-skip-permissions/--mcp-config+--strict-mcp-config/--add-dir; budget carried through, not a flag)/parseResult. OpenRouter provider (kind api) is a clean stub: isAuthed declared, callApi/runJudgeLoop THROW "not implemented" (built in downstream API task). getActiveBackend(overlay) reads overlay.config.backend {provider,model}, defaults to Claude when unset, soft-falls-back to Claude on unknown id. claude-cli.js now RE-EXPORTS the 3 helpers from the Claude provider (identity-equal at runtime) so headless-drain.js + onboard-learn.js keep working UNCHANGED — caller rerouting through getActiveBackend is the NEXT task, not done here. NEW test/llm-backend.test.js: 21 node:test cases all green. Verified `node --check` on lib/headless-drain.js + scripts/onboard-learn.js still parse. Committed 20d5bff on orch/attempt/4b12fe1f-4bef-4c82-908d-0f07f56f3638-14. NOTE: git commit hook printed a non-fatal "touch: cannot touch .git/GRAPH_CHECKPOINT: Not a directory" stderr (worktree .git is a file) — commit still landed cleanly, working tree clean.
